summary: Three churches (St. John the Baptist, Our Lady of Knock Shrine, Sacred Heart Cairo) in one shared bulletin. Weekend Masses, the Wednesday noon and Friday 6:30 PM weekday Masses, Wednesday and Friday Adoration, and all five Reconciliation times agree in all four bulletins. Added the one-time October 27 Adoration day and Holy Hour at Sacred Heart. No open questions.
